name: mcp-x-articles
description: Publish Markdown files as X Articles via official X API v2.

X_OAUTH_CONSUMER_KEY.description: X API Key (Consumer Key) under 'Consumer Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

X_OAUTH_CONSUMER_SECRET.description: X API Key Secret (Consumer Secret) under 'Consumer Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

X_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional X Access Token under 'Authentication Tokens' in https://console.x.com (leave blank to authorize in browser).

X_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Optional X Access Token Secret under 'Authentication Tokens' in https://console.x.com (leave blank to authorize in browser).
